**Finding: compliant** (no redline proposed).

- **No exclusivity on Customer anywhere in the document.** Targeted searches for "exclusive", "sole", "requirements from", and "shall not procure" surfaced only unrelated uses: warranty exclusivity (§ 5.2), nonexclusive licence grants (§§ 5.4, 12.1), tax-exclusive charges (§ 4.3), and "sole discretion" references.
- **§ 4.1 (Charges)** structures charges through Order Forms and Service Option Attachments with no minimum-purchase, all-requirements, or single-source commitment.
- **§ 14.16 (Freedom of Action)** affirmatively confirms "Each party is free to enter into similar agreements with others" — this expressly preserves our ability to source the same services elsewhere, satisfying the preferred position rather than merely the fallback.
- **§ 14.11 (No Resale)** bars resale of the Services only. That is a use restriction, not an exclusive-dealing covenant, and does not limit our procurement freedom, so it is not flagged here.
